desc: 珍珠紫 lilac 冷场配莓果三段渐进，空 pH 轨与礼格三窗承载随肤变色叙事
leaf: 金箔透明随肤变色润色唇膏
name: 冷调莓果随肤变色唇膏款

shots.intent: 在搜索结果缩略图里一眼赢下点击，交代水晶壳套金管与金箔透明膏体。
用膏尖斜切微距加一记推开的透明膏痕，把金箔凝胶质地推到眼前。
用同型三格鼻下唇色从素到莓果的渐进对照，演示随唇而变的显色旅程。
用盖合、开管、立盖三件一组的摆阵，交代双支配盒的组合形态。
用两枚立管旁的四宫格空白图标卡，把配方与人群卖点留成可填版位。
用晨窗梳妆镜前轻涂上唇的瞬间，把产品写进成熟女性的日常仪式。
用持管贴颊的从容肖像与两枚留白胶囊，传递舒适无负担的使用感。
用水晶托盘上的立管与两枚圆角插窗，把金箔与显色一物两证。
收口促单，用随身、上唇、入盒三窗礼赠叙事把两支装送出去。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless ice-porcelain field #F7F8FA for packshot and set frames, pearl-lilac studio wash #EFEAF4 for board and progression screens, one cut-crystal glass tray with gold rail backdrop confined to the vanity still-life frame, soft cool interior daylight blur inside the two portrait frames, no warm candle or champagne silk stages
style.direction: cool pearl-lilac pH colour-change lip commerce with berry payoff accents
style.iconSystem: thin gold line glyphs (droplet, molecule, lip, clock, suitcase, brush, gift) inside blank rounded cards, one empty horizontal gradient scale bar with blank tick ends, tiny four-point star separators, no pH numerals, no minute figures
style.lightingSystem: clean cool beauty light near 6200K, broad wraparound fill, crisp specular chips on the gold columns and foil flakes, even shadowless board interiors, gentle window glow on skin, never amber low-key
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool pearl-lilac pH colour-change lip ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of ice porcelain #F7F8FA, pearl lilac #EFEAF4, berry payoff #B44A7E and brushed antique gold #C09A3E; clean cool beauty light near 6200K with crisp specular chips on gold and foil, shadowless boards and gentle window glow on skin; clear acrylic shells over gold tubes, foil-flecked transparent bullets, a cut-crystal tray with gold rail only in the vanity still life, white marble insets and matte lilac paper, no silk drape, no dark wood, no warm candle or champagne stages; one refined transitional serif kept as empty placeholder cards, pills and scale bars; thin gold line glyphs only; anonymous nose-down lip crops and eye-down portrait crops; no color palette changes, no readable pH values, no brand marks, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting.
noDrift: no readable pH values or timings
no warm champagne or candle stages
style.presentationRules: cases always read as clear shells over gold tubes with unmarked faces, the bullet stays transparent with real foil flakes, lip progression crops are anonymous nose-down tiles, women in portraits are generic mature models cropped from the eyes down or softened
style.surfaceSystem: brushed antique-gold inner tube under a clear acrylic shell, transparent bullet with suspended gold foil, cut-crystal glass dish, white marble inset tiles, matte lilac paper boards, no silk drape, no dark wood
style.typography: one refined transitional serif in plum ink with a light sans subtitle, every headline, icon card, pill and scale label kept as an empty placeholder
